Recognize the approach

Memphis challenged restrained modernist taste with playful patterns, unusual combinations, and emphatic forms.

Look for

  • Squiggles and contrasting patterns
  • Unexpected geometric combinations
  • Deliberately lively color relationships

Your learning goal

Describe the visual decisions before choosing a tool. Then make one small example that uses them deliberately.

Next: Origins

Where it comes from

Memphis challenged restrained modernist taste with playful patterns, unusual combinations, and emphatic forms. A web adaptation can keep that energy while giving information a stable structure.

What to examine

Look at the heading, one control, the image treatment, and the reading order. Explain which decisions establish the style and which make the page usable.

Next: Construction

How to construct it

  1. Create two repeatable SVG patterns and a small shape vocabulary.
  2. Place them around a conventional content layout. Use pattern density to support, rather than obscure, hierarchy.

Small practice task

Design a section with one pattern, two shapes, and three colors. Test whether the main action is still immediately obvious.

Before you expand it

Test the result at its intended size, on a narrow screen, and with keyboard focus. Preserve editable layers and record the source and license of acquired assets.
